instructions.name: buy_exact_out
docs: Buy exactly `tokens_out`, paying at most `max_sol_in` (fees included).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent and the launch fee: the creator in public mode, a relayer in private mode.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Recorded as creator and receives creator fees. Signs so a launch cannot be attributed to someone else.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Emergency switch: stops new launches and buys. Sells, unstaking and
claims always keep working so nobody can be trapped.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Platform settings for future launches and the platform fee. Existing
tokens keep their own curve parameters and creator fees.

errors.name: BadMetadata
errors.msg: Name 1-32, symbol 1-10, uri up to 200 characters

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: Slippage
errors.msg: Price moved beyond your slippage limit

errors.name: StakeTooSmall
errors.msg: Stake at least 1 token (or unstake everything)

fields.name: buy_fee_bps
docs: creator-chosen fee on buys, on top of the platform fee

fields.name: sell_fee_bps
docs: creator-chosen fee on sells, on top of the platform fee

fields.name: holder_share_bps
docs: share of the creator-chosen fees paid to stakers (the rest goes to the creator)
